reference_sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(t.n_products), 2) AS avg_products
FROM (
  -- one row per category with products
  SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS n_products
  FROM products
  GROUP BY category_id
) AS t
alternatives:
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT category_id), 2) AS avg_products
FROM products

WITH category_sizes AS (
  -- one row per category with products
  SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS n_products
  FROM products
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(n_products), 2) AS avg_products
FROM category_sizes

other_way.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT category_id), 2) AS avg_products
FROM products
other_way.tradeoff: Dividing the products by their distinct categories needs no inner step, but only works while no category_id is missing.
